Mira: Uploaded "Sidekick" quickstart mock — tiny banner at top-right with 3 sample projects, CTA and a small "Show again" control. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/sidekick/quickstart
Josh: Banner looks light. For keyboard users, do we trap focus or inert background? Trap on first-run only might be best.
Val: If non-trap, use inert or aria-hidden on underlying content. Also add SR-only descriptions for each sample.
Ana: CTA copy: current "Create sample" feels heavy. Suggest "Try sample" or "Open template". "Try sample" short and friendly.
Mira: Note about telemetry: legal requires EU consent shown; propose one-time consent modal linked from banner footer.
Josh: Contrast: button text at 12px fails 4.5:1. Recommend darker text or semibold. Also visible focus ring.
Val: Accessibility checklist: focus trap option, inert background fallback, SR tile text, contrast check, focus return to banner opener. I'll run a screen-reader pass after updates.
Mira: Action items: Mira -> update figma with SR copy and CTA "Try sample". Josh -> prototype trap + inert. Val -> a11y pass. Ana -> finalize CTA variants. React :thumbsup: if aligned.
